##### Project general facts

The Beach House Fahid by Aldar is a coastal residential collection set in the vibrant heart of an island designed around well-being, offering partial views of the expansive sea and the city skyline. The community comprises eleven elegant buildings, five rising from a ground floor to seven residential floors and the others to nine residential floors, where contemporary architecture blends with the natural surroundings. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including a maid's room.

Amenities are set on a private podium level that serves as a social and recreational hub within a beautifully connected community. Residents enjoy two resort-style swimming pools for relaxing, swimming laps or socialising, and two state-of-the-art gymnasiums for a balanced, active lifestyle. Multipurpose rooms, children's play areas, co-working lounges, lounge areas and community zones and a bicycle parking station complete the offer, while landscaped gardens and the shoreline sit just beyond the podium.

Interiors are styled in a timeless palette of soft neutral colours, warm wood tones and textured finishes inspired by the surrounding beach setting, creating a sense of calm, lightness and effortless sophistication. Generous windows bring in natural light and frame views towards the sea and the gardens, while balconies extend living areas outdoors. The community holds leading sustainability ratings for health and green design. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Fahid Island is the first island in the UAE where well-being is the foundation, set along the coast of Abu Dhabi between Yas Island and Saadiyat Island. A natural beach, a long waterfront boardwalk with watersports, dining and cafes, landscaped berms with fitness and wellness corridors and the Coral Drive boutique shopping boulevard create a vibrant yet calm island lifestyle.

Yas Island is a short drive away, while Saadiyat Island, Zayed International Airport and the centre of Abu Dhabi are within easy reach. Dubai is within comfortable driving distance, and boutique retail, wellness studios and essential services along Coral Drive bring everyday convenience directly to the doorstep of residents and their families, alongside schools, clinics and leisure facilities planned across the island.

Fahid Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most distinctive wellness-led destinations in the region. Apartments close to the beach and set between Yas Island and Saadiyat Island are in high demand from families, professionals and holiday home buyers. A strong master developer and certified sustainable design underpin long-term value and attractive rental prospects for owners.
